entries.name: Chespin
entries.rationale: Def 65 over spe 38 and the genus Spiny Nut with ability Bulletproof point to a sturdy little holding player; height 4 keeps it small and slow.

entries.name: Quilladin
entries.rationale: Def 95 is its standout stat and genus Spiny Armor describes a shelled body, so DEF gets a lift; spe 57 keeps it out of wide roles.

entries.name: Chesnaught
entries.rationale: Def 122, weight 900 and the shield move spiky-shield in kickMoves make it a wall at the back; spe 64 and baseline ACC 50 keep it central.

entries.name: Fennekin
entries.rationale: Spa 62 and spe 60 on a quadruped fox at height 4 give quick, light movement; def 40 and shape quadruped already show in low TAK and HAN.

entries.name: Braixen
entries.rationale: Spa 90 over atk 59 and an upright frame suit a creative attacker; def 58 and weight 145 leave little to win duels with.

entries.name: Delphox
entries.rationale: Spa 114, spe 104 and the psychic type make it a playmaker who directs play from range; the baseline already reflects atk 69, so no change.

entries.name: Froakie
entries.rationale: Spe 71 on a frog genus Bubble Frog at height 3 makes it a nimble leaper, so AER rises from its 31 baseline; def 40 keeps it fragile.

entries.name: Frogadier
entries.rationale: Spe 97 on a humanoid frog with genus Bubble Frog gives springy jumping that AER 45 undersells; def 52 rules out defensive work.

entries.name: Greninja
entries.rationale: Spe 122, atk 95 and spa 103 with genus Ninja and ability Protean make it an elusive forward; ninja leaping earns a small AER bump, while def 67 keeps it out of defence.

entries.name: Bunnelby
entries.rationale: Spe 57 and double-kick in kickMoves give a quick small runner, and ability Huge Power is already priced into SHO by Layer 1; height 4 and def 38 make it easy to knock off the ball.

entries.name: Diggersby
entries.rationale: Hp 85, the ground type and ability Huge Power on a weight 424 digger with genus Digging point to a powerful anchor; spa 50 offers little creativity.

entries.name: Fletchling
entries.rationale: Spe 62 with ability Gale Wings and shape wings make it a darting flyer, already rewarded in AER by Layer 1; weight 17 and height 3 leave no physical presence.

entries.name: Fletchinder
entries.rationale: Spe 84 and ability Gale Wings on shape wings suit a direct wide runner; Layer 1 already raised AER, and def 55 limits defending.

entries.name: Talonflame
entries.rationale: Spe 126 with ability Gale Wings and blaze-kick in kickMoves make it a dive-bombing forward; the baseline already reflects its pace and flight, and shape wings keeps HAN low.

entries.name: Scatterbug
entries.rationale: Spe 35, atk 35 and height 3 on a larva with shape armor leave it a slow blocker at best; nothing in the data supports changing the low baseline.

entries.name: Spewpa
entries.rationale: Shape blob with spe 29 and a cocoon genus line means it barely moves, which ACC 29 already shows after the Layer 1 blob cut; def 60 is its only asset.

entries.name: Vivillon
entries.rationale: Spe 89 and spa 90 on shape bug-wings give a fluttering wide threat; weight 170 hg and def 50 already keep PHY low, so no change.

entries.name: Litleo
entries.rationale: Spe 72 on a quadruped lion cub with ability Moxie suits an eager wide runner; height 6 and def 58 keep it light in duels.

entries.name: Pyroar
entries.rationale: Spe 106 and ability Unnerve on a quadruped lion with genus Royal make it a powerful, imposing runner; weight 815 hg already sets PHY, so no change.

entries.name: Flabébé
entries.rationale: Height 1 and weight 1 make it one of the smallest species, so the Layer 1 arms bonus to HAN overstates any goalkeeping, while height already holds DIV down. Spd 79 and spa 61 point to light link play.

entries.name: Floette
entries.rationale: Height 2 and weight 9 cannot support HAN 64 from the shape arms bonus; spd 98 and spa 75 fit a small creative passer.

entries.name: Florges
entries.rationale: Spd 154 and spa 112 make it a calm playmaker, and the arms shape keeps a goalkeeping option; spe 75 and atk 65 keep it out of the front line.

entries.name: Skiddo
entries.rationale: Hp 66 and genus Mount describe a sure-footed goat that carries riders, so STA rises; spe 52 and shape quadruped keep it central.

entries.name: Gogoat
entries.rationale: Genus Mount describes a ridable workhorse built to carry riders over distance, so STA rises; hp 123 and weight 910 hg already set PHY. ACC 57 and spe 68 suit a central engine rather than a winger.

entries.name: Pancham
entries.rationale: Atk 82, the fighting type and ability Iron Fist give a scrappy brawler, already rewarded by kickMoves in Layer 1; spe 43 and spa 46 limit range and creativity.

entries.name: Pangoro
entries.rationale: Atk 124, weight 1360 and genus Daunting with ability Iron Fist describe a punching bruiser, so TEC and PAS come down from kickMoves inflation; spe 58 and ACC 42 confirm a central role.

entries.name: Furfrou
entries.rationale: Spe 102 on a quadruped dog with genus Poodle gives a quick chaser, and ability Fur Coat adds little to outfield play; quadruped shape already caps HAN.

entries.name: Espurr
entries.rationale: Spe 68 on a small upright cat at height 3 suits nimble wide play; weight 35 and atk 48 leave it easy to push off the ball.

entries.name: Meowstic
entries.rationale: Spe 104 with spa 83 and ability Prankster point to a tricky wide creator; atk 48 and weight 85 keep it from finishing or defending with power.

entries.name: Honedge
entries.rationale: Def 100 over spe 28 on shape blob with genus Sword gives a stationary blocker; Layer 1 already cut its ball skills for the missing legs.

entries.name: Doublade
entries.rationale: Def 150 and atk 110 on twin blades with genus Sword suit hard tackling; the heads shape already cuts DRI and KIC in Layer 1, so no change, and spe 35 confirms a back-line role.

entries.name: Aegislash
entries.rationale: Def 140, spd 140 and the signature kings-shield in kickMoves make a living shield the natural keeper, so HAN rises; shape blob and spe 60 rule out attacking roles.

entries.name: Spritzee
entries.rationale: Ability Healer and hp 78 suit a supportive holding player, but height 2 and weight 5 cannot back HAN 67 from the arms shape bonus; spe 23 is very slow.

entries.name: Aromatisse
entries.rationale: Hp 101, spa 99 and ability Healer on a humanoid make a steady supporting midfielder; spe 29 keeps it far from the flanks.

entries.name: Swirlix
entries.rationale: Spe 49 and def 66 on a light shape legs body with ability Unburden give a balanced small runner; weight 35 and atk 48 limit power.

entries.name: Slurpuff
entries.rationale: Balanced atk 80, spa 85 and spe 72 on a humanoid suit attacking midfield; weight 50 hg already keeps PHY low, so no change.

entries.name: Inkay
entries.rationale: Shape tentacles with ability Suction Cups gives reach for tackles, already credited by Layer 1; atk 54 and height 4 leave little attacking threat.

entries.name: Malamar
entries.rationale: Atk 92 and def 88 with long tentacles under a shape blob tag lost the reach credit Layer 1 gives tentacled bodies, so TAK rises; ability Contrary and genus Overturning add unpredictability.

entries.name: Binacle
entries.rationale: Def 67 and ability Tough Claws on a two-handed rock/water barnacle suit grappling defence; spe 50 and shape heads keep ball skills low.

entries.name: Barbaracle
entries.rationale: Def 115, atk 105 and genus Collective describe a body of many clawed hands, so HAN gets a small lift; ACC 54 and shape heads keep it at the back.

entries.name: Skrelp
entries.rationale: Spe 30 on shape blob with genus Mock Kelp makes it a slow drifter, and the low baseline already reflects that; even spa and spd 60 support a holding role.

entries.name: Dragalge
entries.rationale: Spd 123, def 90 and spa 97 on a weight 815 kelp dragon suit a deep holding player; spe 44 and shape blob already sink its mobility numbers.

entries.name: Clauncher
entries.rationale: Def 62 and spd 63 on shape armor with one oversized claw make a compact defender; spe 44 and kickMoves of only protect keep it unadjusted.

entries.name: Clawitzer
entries.rationale: Spa 120 with ability Mega Launcher and genus Howitzer make its cannon claw a long-range weapon that shape squiggle penalties hide, so SHO rises; spe 59 limits mobility.

entries.name: Helioptile
entries.rationale: Spe 70 and spa 61 on a small upright lizard at height 5 suit quick wide play; def 33 and weight 60 leave it fragile.

entries.name: Heliolisk
entries.rationale: Spe 109 and spa 109 with mega-kick and low-kick in kickMoves give a fast, skilful wide attacker; def 52 and weight 210 keep it out of defence.

entries.name: Tyrunt
entries.rationale: Atk 89 and ability Strong Jaw on genus Royal Heir give a biting tyrannosaur, but its tiny forelimbs make HAN 51 too high; spe 48 keeps it central.

entries.name: Tyrantrum
entries.rationale: Height 25, weight 2700, atk 121 and head-smash in kickMoves make a dominant heading presence, but the tyrannosaur build has tiny forelimbs, so HAN and DIV fall; ACC 50 shows it is slow to turn.

entries.name: Amaura
entries.rationale: Hp 77 and height 13 on a long-necked quadruped of genus Tundra already give it reach in the air, so no change; spe 46 keeps it in a holding role.

entries.name: Aurorus
entries.rationale: Hp 123, height 27 and weight 2250 already drive top AER, PHY and STA; spe 58 and ACC 39 confirm a deep central role.

entries.name: Sylveon
entries.rationale: Spd 130 and spa 110 suit a calm playmaker, and the design's well-known ribbon feelers give tackling reach a quadruped shape misses; spe 60 limits pace.

entries.name: Hawlucha
entries.rationale: Spe 118 and high-jump-kick in kickMoves on genus Wrestling with the flying type describe an aerial grappler, so AER 65 and PHY rise; Layer 1 already rewarded its kicking.

entries.name: Dedenne
entries.rationale: Spe 101 on an upright mouse at height 2 and weight 22 gives darting close control, but that size cannot hit hard, so SHO drops.

entries.name: Carbink
entries.rationale: Def 150 and spd 150 make it very durable; the ball shape already cuts HAN and limits footwork in Layer 1 and height 3 already holds DIV down, so no change.

entries.name: Goomy
entries.rationale: Spd 75 is its best stat and ability Gooey slows attackers it touches; spe 40 and height 3 on shape squiggle are already priced in.

entries.name: Sliggoo
entries.rationale: Spd 113 and spa 83 suit a calm central passer, and shape squiggle already sinks its ball skills; spe 60 keeps it from wide roles.

entries.name: Goodra
entries.rationale: Spd 150, spa 110 and hp 90 on a weight 1505 upright dragon make a commanding central midfielder; ACC 63 and spe 80 keep it out of wide or pace roles.

entries.name: Klefki
entries.rationale: Height 2 and weight 30 hg on shape ball with no legs already keep PHY and DRI low, so no change; ability Prankster and spe 75 fit a tricky floating nuisance.

entries.name: Phantump
entries.rationale: Atk 70 and spd 60 on a small arms-shaped stump give modest all-round value; spe 38 and height 4 keep it slow, as the baseline shows.

entries.name: Trevenant
entries.rationale: Atk 110, weight 710 and shape tentacles for its root legs give a strong reaching defender; spe 56 and ACC 46 match the rooted genus Elder Tree.

entries.name: Pumpkaboo
entries.rationale: Def 70 and spe 51 on shape ball give a small defensive runner; Layer 1 already cut its ball skills for having no legs.

entries.name: Gourgeist
entries.rationale: Def 122 and spe 84 suit a sturdy keeper, and its hair-like arms grab what shape blob credits as no hands, so HAN rises.

entries.name: Bergmite
entries.rationale: Def 85 and weight 995 with ability Sturdy make a dense blocker; spe 28 is already reflected in PAC 32 and ACC 29.

entries.name: Avalugg
entries.rationale: Genus Iceberg makes it an immovable wall beyond what def 184 alone shows, so DEF rises a little, while a quadruped iceberg with spe 28 cannot strike or kick at SHO 68 and KIC 81.

entries.name: Noibat
entries.rationale: Spe 55 on shape wings at weight 80 gives a light flyer already credited in AER by Layer 1; atk 30 offers no threat.

entries.name: Noivern
entries.rationale: Spe 123 and spa 97 on shape wings with genus Sound Wave make a fast wide flyer; Layer 1 already added AER and vision, so no change.

entries.name: Xerneas
entries.rationale: Spe 99 on a quadruped deer with genus Life suits long bounding runs, which the baseline already prices with weight 2150 hg, so no change; hp 126 and balanced atk and spa 131 cover both ends.

entries.name: Yveltal
entries.rationale: Height 58 and AER 99 on shape wings with atk and spa 131 give a towering defender; DRI 74 on wings fits the baseline already.

entries.name: Zygarde
entries.rationale: Def 121, hp 108 and height 50 on shape squiggle make a huge serpentine blocker; Layer 1 already removed its ball skills for having no legs.

entries.name: Diancie
entries.rationale: Def 150 and spd 150 give a resilient central player, but height 7 and weight 88 make HAN 98 from the arms bonus too high; spe 50 keeps it slow.

entries.name: Hoopa
entries.rationale: Spa 150 and atk 110 with genus Mischief and its portal rings make a creative attacker; height 5 and def 60 keep it out of defence.

entries.name: Volcanion
entries.rationale: Def 120, spa 130 and weight 1950 on a quadruped give a heavy central anchor; spe 70 and shape quadruped already show in ACC 56 and DRI 58.
